crosswalk.loss: Identity needs its WFD namespace; administrative segmentation, heavily-modified designation and source reference boundary remain native. Not instantaneous wet extent.
OS/UWWTD source convention and simplification must remain; actual survey date/tidal datum details unknown.
Month/cell and classification lineage mandatory; no instantaneous edge, depth, tide or feature identity.
Keep numeric value and observation-conditioned period; binary water discards history, no present-state equivalence.
Saltmarsh vegetation, saline/intertidal context and habitat ontology lost in broad wetland label; not open-water state.
Reed vegetation/ecological definition and mixed-habitat co-membership lost.
Periodically inundated pasture/meadow, ditch system and management meaning not equivalent to saturated/open water everywhere.
Fine sediment/ecology and native extent/grain remain; current water presence cannot be inferred.
AEP/source/defence convention and mixed origins retained; this is neither a dated inundation state nor local pixel confidence.
Event ID, interval, boundary evidence, cause and quality retained; footprint need not be synchronous maximum at every point.
Reference/habitat/scenario claim cannot be relabelled as current observed state.
No valid observations; physical state unknown.
Native co-membership provides no fractional split or dominant label.
Generic water-related category merges feature, state, habitat and scenario; deliberately rejected as sole interpretation.

method: Exact native polygon intersection/unions in BNG; transformed native raster centre counts, no raster resampling, confidence estimation, classification or hydrological modelling. Overlap is support, not truth or simultaneous state. No-observations excluded from paired detected/non-detected comparisons.
